findings.title: Public findMany() removed and replaced by getBaseConditions() without updating callers
findings.body: The `findMany` method was removed and replaced by `getBaseConditions()`, which returns only a raw `Prisma.Sql` fragment. Any existing caller of `InsightsBookingService.findMany(...)` will fail to compile or break at runtime, and callers that relied on Prisma `select`/`where` arguments have no equivalent. The PR does not show any caller migration, so this is a breaking API change hidden inside a test-focused PR. Callers need to be found and migrated, or the change should be called out explicitly.

findings.title: Caching tests deleted with no replacement
findings.body: The `Caching` describe block (verifying that getAuthorizationConditions and getFilterConditions return memoized results on the second call) was removed entirely, and the PR description does not mention it. The service still implements memoization via cachedAuthConditions/cachedFilterConditions, so that behavior is now untested.

findings.title: PR description says the service was already converted, but this PR changes the service too
findings.body: The description states the Prisma.sql conversion was 'previously converted in the service implementation' and that this PR only updates tests. The diff, however, rewrites insightsBooking.ts (new SQL-building logic, removed findMany, changed types and constructor option type). Reviewers relying on the description would under-scope the review of the high-risk authorization SQL.
